hero_title: New Energy Powers a Better Life.
hero_text: Gas generators, CNG storage, refuelling and regulation, all built by Pulita. Download the specifications for every model.
overview_text: Tap a product to see its specifications. Every table can be downloaded as a PDF, and each generator and MRU model has its own PDF datasheet.
cng_generator_text: Pulita CNG generator sets run on compressed or pipeline natural gas for continuous 24-hour duty in hospitals, factories, estates and telecom sites. Larger plants are containerized and can be synchronised to match any load.
lpg_generator_text: LPG generator sets for sites without natural gas. They run from cylinders or a bulk tank, start with one button and cut fuel costs sharply compared with diesel. LPG generator sets can be configured for dual-fuel (LPG/CNG) operation based on customer requirements.
biogas_generator_text: Biogas generator sets turn gas from digesters, farms, food processing, wastewater and landfill into electricity. We configure each set to your gas analysis and pair it with gas treatment to remove H₂S and moisture.
cng_cascade_text: Pulita assembles 150–200 L cylinders into CNG cascades for on-site gas storage. Cascades feed gas generators through a PRMS, and store gas at MRUs and daughter stations, wherever there is no pipeline.
mru_text: The MRU is a complete CNG daughter station on one skid: hydraulic compressor, gas storage, dispenser, metering, filtration and gas-leak alarms. It arrives ready to connect, needs no major civil works and can be relocated as demand grows.
prms_text: The pressure regulating and metering skid (PRMS) steps high-pressure CNG or pipeline gas down to the pressure your equipment needs, heats it to prevent freezing and meters every cubic metre for accurate cost control.
